# Hostile argument vectors for templates/poc/run.sh, the installation's copy. test-dnr-poc-runner.sh runs
# each one under each bash on the machine, from a working directory that is not a repository and holds
# the run directories audit_1 and incident_1 (made by scripts/rundir.sh); audit_1/exec-mode holding
# native; the crate audit_1/poc/F-1; audit_1/exec/build-sbf-1/vuln.so, fixed.so and notes.txt; the file
# a.rs; the directory src/; and linkdir, a symbolic link to audit_1. AUDITOR_EXEC_MODE is not set.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each
# case prints nothing on stdout, makes no scratch directory and changes nothing in the working directory.
# what run.sh takes
